messages:
mike: quick sync 1: thinking about a 'binding adapter' so CP only needs one tiny connectivity contract. adapter hides peering vs private-endpoint vs gateway.

sarah: nice. shorter CP surface is a win. what's the contract footprint?

mike: keep it tiny: id, hostnames, endpoints (ordered), auth type, health path, ip_hints, flags. adapter handles SNAT/preserve semantics.

ben: failure modes? if a regional adapter dies, CP needs fallback. and customers want static IPs for allowlists.
mike: bind exposes an ordered endpoint list. CP tries primary then fallback. ip_hints lets us publish a CIDR pack for customers. adapter enforces affinity/SNAT.

anuj: mtls lifecycle: CP should issue short-lived client certs. adapters call a rotation webhook to fetch fresh certs; this centralizes trust.

maria: migration: dual-mode support. a binding can reference legacy peering while we deploy an adapter. need a migration job and audit logs when we flip.

jess: rollout plan: sandbox tenants -> shadowing -> small canary -> bulk. e2e smoke: probe, failover, cert rotation, verify cidr export.

mike: sample payload (toy): {binding_id: bind-5190, hostnames: ["cp.us-west.5187.internal"], endpoints: [{region: us-west-2, addr: 10.10.7.11, priority:0}], auth: mtls, health: /healthz, ip_hints: ["10.10.0.0/16"], flags: ["preserve_source_ip"]}

ben: whitelist metadata keys (cost_tier, latency_slo_ms, preserve_source_ip) to avoid drift.

anuj: adapters must validate CP certs and log handshake events centrally. rotation webhook should verify adapter identity before issuing creds.

maria: ops needs a per-binding dashboard (probe latency, cert fingerprint, last failover), CIDR export, and rollback playbook. audit trail required for flips.

mike: i'll write an RFC with contract, handshake sequence diagram, migration job design, rollout checklist, and tests. aiming to post Tue for review.

deploy-bot: mike opened draft-rfc/thin-binding-adapter (PR: https://git.internal/rfcs/704)

mike: thanks; please leave PR comments early if you spot issues.
